answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, each submission carries a fresh nonce. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The umber holds work receipts rather than names, so the summit of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
